basic_details.short_information: The ICMR National Institute for Tribal Health Research (ICMR NITHR) Project Research Scientist / Technical Support / Field Worker / Assistant Notification 2026 has been released on the official website of ICMR NITHR. A total of 19 vacancies have been announced through the ICMR NITHR Recruitment 2026 for various contractual project posts.

qualification.education_qualification: MBBS/BVSc/BDS with PG/PhD, Post Graduate Degree, 12th/Diploma/MLT, Graduate
qualification.details: Project Research Scientist-III (Medical/Non-Medical): MBBS/BVSc./BDS + Post Graduate Degree (MD/MVSc./MDS/MPH), including the integrated PG degrees with three years' post qualification experience or MBBS/BVSc./BDS With MPH/PHD with three years' post qualification experience. Or Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees, with five years' experience post qualification experience or PhD + two years post qualification experience. Project Research Scientist-II (Medical/Non-Medical): MBBS/BVSc/BDS with three years post qualification experience or MBBS/BVSc/BDS + Post Graduate Degree (MD/MVSc./MDS/MPH) or any equivalent degree, including integrated PG Degrees or MBBS/BVSc/BDS with PhD or Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG Degrees, with three years post qualification experience or PHD. Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical): Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG Degrees, with three years post qualification experience or PHD. Lab Technician (PTS-II): 12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/Engineering or equivalent) + Five Years' Experience in relevant Subject/field or Three years Graduate degree in relevant subject/field + two year experience in relevant subject or Candidates possessing a Post-Graduate (PG) degree in the relevant discipline shall be deemed full eligible. Data Entry Operator: Intermediate or 12th Pass in science stream from recognized board with DOEACC 'A' level from a recognized institute and / or 2 Years' experience in EDP work in Government, Autonomous, PSU or any other recognized organization. A Speed test of not less than 15000 key depressions per hours through speed test on computer. Project Research Scientist-II (Medical): MBBS/BVSc/BDS with three years post qualification experience or MBBS/BVSc/BDS + Post Graduate Degree (MD/MVSc./MDS/MPH) or any equivalent degree, including integrated PG Degrees or MBBS/BVSc/BDS with PhD. Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) (Social Science): Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degree in relevant subject. Project Technical Support – I: 10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/IT or equivalent) + two years' Experience in relevant Subject/field or Three years Graduate degree in relevant subject/field + one year experience in relevant subject or Candidates possessing a Post-Graduate (PG) degree in the relevant discipline shall be deemed full eligible. Field Worker (Project Technical Support – II): 12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/Engineering or equivalent) + Five Years' Experience in relevant subject/field or Three years Graduate degree in relevant subject/field + two year experience in relevant subject or Candidates possessing a Post-Graduate (PG) degree in the relevant discipline shall be deemed full eligible. Project Assistant Multipurpose (Admin): Graduate in any discipline with 2 years' experience in administrative work. Project Technical Support – III (Project Associate-I): Three years graduate degree in relevant subject /field + three Years post qualification experience or PG in relevant subject /field. Project Associate-I: As per ANRF Guidelines - Four years Bachelor's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences/ Master Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences/ BVSc./B. Pharm or Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine or Form a recognized University or equivalent. Project Technical Support – III (Project Assistant I): Three years graduate degree in relevant subject /field + three Years post qualification experience or PG in relevant subject /field.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICMR NITHR Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICMR NITHR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the ICMR NITHR Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 29th July 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the ICMR NITHR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 19 vacancies announced for various posts including Project Research Scientist, Technical Support, Field Worker, and Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for ICMR NITHR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the ICMR NITHR Recruitment 2026 notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required for the Project Research Scientist posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for Project Research Scientist posts varies, but generally includes MBBS/BVSc/BDS with PG/PhD or a Post Graduate Degree with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for ICMR NITHR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with their documents.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at ICMR National Institute for Tribal Health Research, Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, 482003.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support posts?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Technical Support posts ranges from Rs. 18,000/- to Rs. 20,000/- per month, plus HRA as applicable.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation will be provided to reserved categories as per the rules of the Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT), Government of India.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply for multiple posts?
faq.answer: The notification does not explicitly mention restrictions on applying for multiple posts. However, candidates should ensure they meet the eligibility criteria for each post they are interested in.
